title: Workspace ProjectMember lock capabilities
description: Caller-transactional Workspace-owned ProjectMember row reads and locks. The caller owns authorization, transaction ordering, and commit.

ProjectMemberRowsJson.description: Text JSON array of ordered complete nine-column ProjectMember rows; an empty match returns [].

lock_contention.translation: None; the caller retains its existing SQLSTATE handling.

x-native-capabilities.authorization_boundary: Neither function checks actors or decides permissions; callers provide the authorization workflow.

functions.name: lock_project_member_reference
functions.transaction_semantics: Acquire FOR SHARE on the matching ProjectMember in the caller's transaction, with NOWAIT selected by p_nowait. Return its user UUID or null for null/missing references. Lock SQLSTATEs propagate unchanged.

functions.name: project_member_rows
functions.transaction_semantics: With p_lock_members=true, acquire FOR SHARE on all matching ProjectMember rows in one ordered set query; false performs the same ordered row read without locks. Return complete nine-column JSON snapshots ordered by user_id; no rows return []. The caller owns identity-map merging and commit.

x-native-capabilities.transaction_boundary: The caller owns the surrounding transaction and commit.
